definitions.gloss: contract partner; contracted party; company or person one has a contract with
definitions.explanation: The other party in a contractual relationship — the company, organization, or individual with whom one has signed an agreement. Used in business, employment, and service contexts.

examples.japanese: {契約先|けいやくさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to change my contract partner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{契約先|けいやくさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: We found a new contract partner.

examples.japanese: {契約先|けいやくさき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ→打ち合わせ：07155_uchiawase⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}する→出張する：26986_shucchousuru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm scheduled to travel on business next week for a meeting with the contract partner.

notes:
Combines ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧ (contract) and ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination, counterpart). The {〜先|さき} suffix is productive in business Japanese, indicating the other party or destination in a relationship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {契約先|けいやくさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for a contract partner
- {契約先|けいやくさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change one's contracted party
- {契約先|けいやくさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: the contracted company
- ⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧{契約先|けいやくさき}: main contract partners

RELATED {〜先|さき} COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧: business partner, client — a company one does business with (broader than {契約先|けいやくさき})
- ⟦{勤務先|きんむさき}→勤務先：08368_kinmusaki⟧: place of employment
- ⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧: contact information
- ⟦{仕入|しい}れ→仕入れ：07431_shiire⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: supplier, purchasing source

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧: business partner — broader, referring to any company one has business dealings with, not necessarily through a formal contract
- ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧: contracting party — more explicitly refers to the other side in a contract, whereas {契約先|けいやくさき} is more concise
